title: Polish the standings page on phone
request: the standings page on my phone

criteria.text: Podium team names show up to 2 lines and have a title, so teams with a shared prefix are told apart at 390px
Selected Compact/Detailed item is visually distinct from keyboard focus (focus ring stays, selected uses fill only)
Compact-row team link is at least 44px tall
Division/All and Compact/Detailed toggle items are at least 44px tall and wide
Empty-state text no longer mentions a division control that is not on that screen
No new console errors, no sideways scroll at 360 and 390px, touched components' tests pass

interventions.why: Asked Doug how to get data for screenshots; answer: fake test data (mock)

notes.text: Left alone on purpose: power-score light-theme contrast (shared by ~10 views, needs Doug), chart dead space, error-state height, decorative dot. Human choice: fake-data screenshots.
